Messages.Author: TryDeflectingThisGrapple
Messages.Body:
> extrala wrote:
> 3. Can somebody please tell me about the results of the NW Qualifier 2015? There's a TWD posted, but no results (yet) in the event calendar.
>
I'm sure Grayson will upload the Archon soon, if he hasn't already.

Finals were as follows:

Fletcher Gibson (4th seed, TurboBaron: Possession variant) --> Ethan Gunsul (3rd seed, Gangrel bleed + Thing bloat + rush allies) --> Brian Moritz (1st seed, EU Brujah w/o Govern) --> Grayson Nootenboom (2nd seed, G3/4 Nos toolbox) --> Darby Keeney (5th seed, Legacy of Pander + Rising).

Fletcher couldn't get a Villein to start the turbo movement, Ethan kept getting blocked by Brian, Darby was hamstrung by something like 12 votes against almost everything that reached the table, Grayson finally had to backrush Brian (who had been the most effective predator up until that point).

That turn lead to some truly unholy deal-making, culminating in Fletcher's and Grayson's demise (Brian 1 VP, Darby 1 VP). After concerted attempt to reach a Darby-Ethan heads-up failed, the Pander resorted to swarm bleeding for 2 more VP (Darby 4 VP, Brian 1 VP).
